title: Senior Finance Data Analyst
description:
Senior Finance Data AnalystClient Overview


Our client operates in the insurance industry and is recruiting a Senior Finance Data Analyst for a permanent position within the Finance department.

What you'll be doing:

  • Perform detailed analytical reviews of underwriting results, broker balances, syndicate expenses, capital movements and quarterly performance to identify trends and key drivers.
  • Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Finance, Actuarial, Underwriting, Compliance, Internal Audit and external auditors to ensure efficient delivery of reporting requirements.
  • Review and enhance reporting processes, controls and documentation to improve reporting quality, efficiency and consistency across the Lloyd's reporting cycle.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to junior team members and assist with the development of reporting capability across the team.
  • Monitor changes in Lloyd's, PRA and regulatory reporting requirements and assess the impact on existing reporting processes.


Our must-haves:

  • Demonstrate exceptional analytical and data interrogation skills, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies and key insights from large and sophisticated data-sets.
  • Experience of Alteryx is strongly preferred
  • Have advanced Excel skills and experience working with large volumes of financial and regulatory data to produce accurate, high-quality reporting.
  • Be highly data-driven, with a natural curiosity to understand the story behind the numbers and challenge outputs where appropriate.
  • Have experience using reporting tools and technology solutions to improve efficiency, automation and reporting capability.
  • Demonstrate excellent attention to detail, ensuring reporting outputs are accurate, complete and delivered to a consistently high standard.
  • Capable of translating complex financial and regulatory information into clear, concise and meaningful commentary for senior partners.
